limitations: Virtual phone viewport/DPR does not emulate phone CPU, GPU, memory bandwidth or thermal behaviour.
SwiftShader render cadence is a software renderer measurement, not evidence that a medium phone meets 30fps.
Actor CPU timing excludes WebGL rendering; normal cadence includes production rendering and camera/scene work.
Optional CDP4×CPU slowdown is an artificial host stress estimate and is reset to1 before normal rendering.
GPU texture count is a live renderer resource count; RGBA8+mipmap byte totals are estimates, not measured GPU byte allocation.
pass records successful stable-input profiling with no remote requests or script failures; it is not a phone-performance acceptance result.
